title: Spatial Transcriptomics Deconvolution and Integration in R
text: STRIDER (Spatial Transcriptomics deconvoluTion integRation Developed Environment R) comprehensive R package analysis spatial transcriptomics data. provides unified framework cell type deconvolution, multi-sample integration, spatial domain identification. Spatial transcriptomics technologies enable measurement gene expression preserving spatial context, platforms capture mixtures cells within measurement spot. STRIDER addresses challenge leveraging topic modeling approaches decompose spatial spots constituent cell type proportions, enabling downstream biological interpretation tissue microenvironments.

title: Spatial Transcriptomics Deconvolution and Integration in R
text: Cell Type Deconvolution: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA)-based decomposition spatial spots cell type proportions using single-cell RNA-seq reference data Multi-Sample Integration: Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) optimal transport alignment integration multiple spatial transcriptomics samples Spatial Domain Identification: Neighborhood-aware clustering incorporates cell type composition spatial proximity Spot-Cell Mapping: Identification transcriptionally similar single cells spatial spot Visualization: Publication-ready visualizations including scatter pie plots, spatial heatmaps, integration plots

title: Spatial Transcriptomics Deconvolution and Integration in R
text: STRIDER employs topic modeling framework : - Documents correspond spatial spots - Words correspond genes - Topics represent latent cell type signatures deconvolution process consists : Model Training: LDA model trained single-cell reference data learn topic-gene distributions (φ) cell-topic distributions (θ) Topic-Celltype Association: Topic distributions aggregated across cells type establish topic-celltype relationships Inference: trained model infers topic distributions spatial spots Deconvolution: Cell type fractions computed using Bayesian inference: P(celltype|topic)=P(topic|celltype)⋅P(celltype)P(topic)P(\text{celltype}|\text{topic}) = \frac{P(\text{topic}|\text{celltype}) \cdot P(\text{celltype})}{P(\text{topic})}

title: Spatial Transcriptomics Deconvolution and Integration in R
text: integrating multiple spatial samples, STRIDER implements Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) optimal transport, jointly optimizes: Feature similarity: KL divergence topic distributions Structural similarity: Gromov-Wasserstein distance preserving spatial relationships FGW distance defined : FGW(μ,ν)=minπ(1−α)⟨M,π⟩+α⋅GW(C1,C2,π)\text{FGW}(\mu, \nu) = \min_{\pi} (1-\alpha) \langle M, \pi \rangle + \alpha \cdot \text{GW}(C_1, C_2, \pi) α balances feature structural costs, optimization solved via conditional gradient descent Sinkhorn projections.

title: Calculate LDA Coherence Score — calculate_coherence
text: UMass coherence measures often top words co-occur corpus: C_UMass = sum_j=2^M sum_i=1^j-1 log((D(w_i, w_j) + 1) / D(w_i)) C_v coherence uses normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI) sliding window cosine similarity, providing better correlation human judgments.
